title: Routing freeze manifest — sanitized and provider-agnostic
description: The DAL-025 read-only export of the host's configured routing, with every credential reduced to a location/role reference (sha256) and every provider/agent/CCR choice recorded as a data row rather than a schema key. The contract is invariant to future changes of agent, provider and CCR configuration: a value change re-freezes the digest (drift detection); a shape change is absorbed by the fail-closed completeness witness (`redacted`) without ever widening this schema.

host.description: Which machine the freeze was taken on (home-mac / ecs).

cli.description: Every agent CLI present, with its version. Agent is a VALUE, never a schema key.

agent.description: Agent family: codex / claude-code / ccr / any future agent.

providers.description: Provider choices, one row per provider. A new provider is a new row, not a schema change.

models.description: Model identifiers routed through this provider.

endpoints.description: Pinned endpoint host:port pairs. Host and port are both frozen.

routing.description: The routing slots (primary / fallback / classifier / review). Slot is a stable role vocabulary, independent of which provider fills it.

slot.description: primary / fallback / classifier / review — a role, not a provider name.

credentials.description: Every credential, reduced to a role + a sha256 reference. The secret value never appears, in the manifest or in the digest input.

role.description: How the credential is held, by structural role — not by which provider owns it.

ref.description: sha256 of the credential's location (path) or, for inline secret fields, of the value. Detects drift without revealing it.

mode.description: Compliance facts for the auth-store role (DAL-006 §3.3).

redacted.description: Completeness witness. Every config field the exporter could not classify as routing/version/usage-state is force-redacted and its path listed here. Empty means nothing fell through unclassified — a structural proof that no unknown field silently entered the freeze. This is the fail-closed invariant that keeps the rules forward-compatible with future provider/agent/CCR shapes.

violations.description: Credential-compliance hard gate (DAL-006 §3.3): credential stores must be 0600 file / 0700 parent. Empty means compliant. A non-empty list marks the freeze non-compliant and the downstream preflight/adapter must refuse it. A plaintext key inside a 0600-protected third-party store is NOT a violation — Henson ruled (2026-08-22, option 2) that the 'no plaintext' gate applies only to credentials the DAL system itself writes; CCR-native storage is judged by file permissions. The pinned-host runtime check is deliberately NOT here — that is DAL-026's job.

code.description: loose-file-perm = store file not 0600; loose-parent-perm = store dir not 0700; unreadable = could not be opened read-only to verify (fail closed).

plaintext_credentials.description: Informational, NOT a hard gate. CCR-native credentials stored unencrypted at rest, detected without ever outputting a key value (name only). Henson accepted these as CCR-native on 2026-08-22 (option 2); they are recorded so the fact stays visible and drift-tracked, but they do not mark the freeze non-compliant.
